title: KITTI odometry — sequence 07
description: KITTI odometry sequence 07 (raw drive 2011_09_30_drive_0027: Velodyne HDL-64E + OXTS RT3003 IMU at 100 Hz, about 694 m), from the kitti_to_ros ROS 1 bag, converted to the canonical bag. Trajectories are evaluated against the KITTI odometry ground-truth poses (Velodyne frame). No TLS map, so there are no point-cloud metrics.
